versions.content: The FEE module shall call the function defined in the configuration parameter FeeNvmJobErrorNotification upon failure of an asynchronous operation and after performing all necessary internal management and error handling operations: - Read job finished & failed (e.g. block invalid or inconsistent) - Write job finished & failed & block marked as invalid - Erase job for immediate data finished & failed (see SWS_Fee_00067) - Invalidation of memory block finished & failed
